concerns.text: T006.3 (Define 'Label Independence' metric) and T006.4 (Implement audit logic) are placed in Phase 2 (Foundational) but depend on the existence of `labels.csv` (specifically the `depth_confidence_score` and `physical_label` columns) which is only generated in Phase 4 (T020-T025). A task cannot define/audit a metric against an artifact that does not yet exist. T006.3/T006.4 must be moved to Phase 5 (US3) or Phase 3 (Prior Audit) to follow the producer-before-consumer rule.

The dependency chain T012.0 (Curate) -> T012.2 (Select/Stream) -> T012.1 (Extract) is logically sound, but T012.1 (Extract) depends on the LingBot-Video model weights (FR-001). There is no explicit task in Phase 1 or 2 to download the model weights before T012.1 attempts to use them. T012.1 implicitly consumes an artifact (model weights) that is not produced by a preceding task in the list.

T036.1 (Verify Independence) is correctly placed after T025 (Labels), but T036 (Main Pipeline/Manifest) depends on T036.1. However, T036 also depends on T039.1 (Measure pipeline time) which is listed as a dependency in the 'Specific Task Dependencies' section. T039.1 is in Phase 6 (Polish), while T036 is in Phase 5. This creates a circular or backward dependency where a Phase 5 task (T036) waits for a Phase 6 task (T039.1) to complete before it can hash the manifest. T039.1 should be moved to Phase 5 or T036 should not depend on the final time log for the initial manifest.

T007 (Create base data models) and T007.1 (Define all data models) are redundant and appear to be the same task split into two. T007 is marked [X] (done) while T007.1 is [ ]. This suggests a copy-paste error or a split that violates the 'atomic task' principle. T007.1 should be removed or merged into T007 to avoid confusion in the execution order.

T024.1 (Verify filtering logic) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on T024 (Labeling step) which generates the `labels.csv` and `excluded_samples.log`. While T024.1 can run in parallel with other US2 tasks, it cannot run in parallel with T024 itself. The [P] tag is acceptable if interpreted as 'parallel with other US2 tasks', but the dependency note 'T024.1 must complete before T030' is correct. However, the description of T024.1 implies it runs *after* T024, which is standard, but the [P] tag might mislead an executor to think it can run before T024.
